exchanges.name: negotiate_past_a_text_message
messages: Safety Setup has not been confirmed yet, therefore no data will be send yet

exchanges.name: negotiate_refused
exchanges.error: this controller refused RTDE protocol version 2. Version 1 has no frequency field on the output setup and this client does not speak it.

exchanges.name: setup_outputs_in_use
exchanges.error: the controller answered `IN_USE` for output variable(s) actual_current, which means one of two things and the first is far more common: **another RTDE client already holds them** — the general-purpose registers are allocated to one session at a time, and a driver that was not closed cleanly keeps them for a few seconds after its socket goes — or this controller does not have the variable at all, which is a name from a newer PolyScope. Either way the recipe is refused here rather than used, because RTDE answers `IN_USE` *in place of a type* and a client that did not look would decode every field after it at the wrong offset.

exchanges.name: start_refused
exchanges.error: the controller refused to start the data exchange. A recipe that was never set up, or another client already holding the session, are the two causes.

program:
def skynet_control():
  while (True):
    cmd = read_input_integer_register(0)
    if cmd == 1:
      q = [read_input_float_register(0),
           read_input_float_register(1),
           read_input_float_register(2),
           read_input_float_register(3),
           read_input_float_register(4),
           read_input_float_register(5)]
      servoj(q, 0, 0, 0.008, 0.1, 300)
    else:
      sync()
    end
  end
end
